result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but the selected navigation state appears inconsistent with the content, and the fixed bottom navigation slightly obscures the restaurant feed.

issues.description: The Profile tab is highlighted in green even though the visible page is clearly the Home restaurant-discovery feed.
issues.suggestion: Highlight the Home tab while this feed is displayed, or navigate to the Profile screen when Profile is selected.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower portion of the second restaurant card, making some content appear cut off behind the navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or ensure the last card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation.
